description: This file defines a GatewayConnection class for managing WebSocket-based communication with a server, including request handling, subscription management, and various API methods for interacting with chat, system, skills, sessions, voice wake triggers, node and device pairing, and scheduling jobs (cron). It also includes enums and data structures related to channels, agent invocations, and health snapshots.

classes.name: GatewayConnection
classes.description: An actor class managing a websocket connection for API requests, subscriptions, and message handling with the server.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an API request with specified method and parameters, handling retries and error recovery.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Configures or reconfigures the socket connection.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous stream of GatewayPush updates for clients.

methods.name: sendAgent
methods.description: Sends a message or invocation to the server related to agent chats or commands.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the gateway connection.

methods.name: healthSnapshot
methods.description: Fetches the current health snapshot from the gateway.

methods.name: skillsStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of skills installed in the gateway.

methods.name: cronList
methods.description: Fetches a list of scheduled cron jobs.

methods.name: cronRun
methods.description: Triggers execution of a specific cron job, with optional force.
